name: Bjornsdottir
saga: Venus holds about four and a third times Earth’s nitrogen and it is the one bulk element a sealed deck cannot manufacture. The Bjornsdottirs are the only clan whose input is genuinely free, and they are the ones who never boast about output.

tiers.note: A bed, an inoculum, and a long wait.
The second bed is seeded from the first, so it starts where the first finished.
Three beds on rotation. None of them is ever idle and none is ever finished.
The rotation is what produces, not the beds. Adding a bed adds a phase.
Five phases, and the output stops looking like a batch.
